newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan paper/pulp shares down on cloudy outlook.
newsitem.headline: Japan paper/pulp shares down on cloudy outlook.

text.p: Shares of paper and pulp companies slipped across the board on Wednesday afternoon, dragged down by expectations that their corporate earnings are likely to be sluggish, traders said.

At 0510 GMT, New Oji Paper Co Ltd was down 28 yen at 818 yen, while Honshu Paper Co Ltd was down 26 yen at 670 yen. Nippon Paper Industries Co Ltd dipped 10 yen to 660 yen. Mitsubishi Paper Paper Mills Ltd also dropped 14 yen to 596 yen.

"Expectations that these firms' sluggishness in the first half of this business year may hurt their half-year corporate results prompted fund managers to exclude the issues from their portfolios," said an analyst at a second-tier Japanese securities house.

"The issues were affected by Honshu Paper, which will be taken out of the Nikkei 225 (on September 24) and sales are being invited on the announcement," said an investment advisory firm's fund manager.
